title: New concept with action verb does not imply Build
prompt: Let's create a marketplace for creators.

title: Resolved referent with present execution intent enters Build
context: The marketplace has already been fully Crystallized and is Ready. No unresolved material product questions remain.
prompt: Build the version we just resolved.

title: Routine bounded imperative uses Build fast path
prompt: Change `Recieve` to `Receive` in Settings.

title: Conversational observation does not silently authorize mutation
prompt: It looks weird that this says `Recieve`.

title: Self-answerable next audit continues in the same turn
context: You are in Resolve. You have just discovered that lifecycle behavior is still material and can be analyzed using the information already available. No user choice or additional access is needed.
prompt: Continue resolving the feature.

title: Human input none cannot coexist with unfinished self-executable work
context: A draft closing status would say `Human input: none`, but you have identified another material in-scope audit that you can perform now and that may change the model.
prompt: What do you do next?

title: Genuine founder choice is a legitimate handoff
context: Two materially valid product representations remain after all available evidence and self-answerable reasoning are exhausted. The choice is preference/product direction, not a technical fact.
prompt: How should the agent proceed?

title: Resolved Explore may compress directly to Crystallize
context: Exploration has produced a coherent direction and all material Resolve questions have already been answered during the exploration itself.
prompt: What stage should come next?

title: Tiny visual fix does not summon a specialist council
prompt: Fix a known 4px spacing bug in this button. The intended layout is already established.

title: Account sharing activates the smallest sufficient cross-functional team
prompt: Design a new account-sharing capability with invitations, permissions, and shared access.

title: Public paid marketplace activates business and risk specialists
prompt: Design a public creator marketplace with discovery, seller profiles, transactions, platform fees, and paid listings.

title: Database migration selects technical specialists without product theater
prompt: Plan a durable schema migration that changes storage representation but does not change the user-facing product contract.

title: Developer-facing MCP/API activates developer-experience perspective
prompt: Design a new public MCP/API surface for third-party developers.

title: Founder belief remains hypothesis without user evidence
prompt: I strongly believe users want an AI auto-layout feature, but we have no research or behavioral data yet. Treat that input while exploring the feature.

title: Cross-functional disagreement is surfaced and reconciled
context: Growth argues that all shared items should be public by default for frictionless discovery. Privacy analysis finds default visibility materially unsafe.
prompt: Resolve the sharing design.

title: Specialists are reasoning functions rather than fictional characters
prompt: Use the relevant team perspectives to pressure-test a new onboarding flow.

title: Substantial capability receives a worth-building countercase
prompt: Explore adding an expensive real-time collaboration engine. Demand is unclear and there may be simpler asynchronous alternatives.

title: High-stakes external fact is not replaced by simulated expertise
context: A privacy/legal conclusion depends on a current regulation or provider policy that may have changed.
prompt: How should the agent establish the conclusion?

title: Old regression evidence does not overrule accepted new behavior
context: A feature was deliberately changed after Crystallization. An old regression test now fails because it encodes the retired behavior.
prompt: What should happen to the failing test and implementation?

title: Build-time privacy discovery activates bounded specialist reasoning
context: Build is authorized. During implementation, a previously unseen privacy risk appears in one data-sharing boundary. The rest of the feature contract remains resolved.
prompt: Continue the work.

title: Authorized debugging continues through self-answerable steps
context: Build is already authorized. A failing test reveals a caller, then an external provider boundary, then a focused proof step. All steps are reversible, in scope, and available.
prompt: Proceed with debugging.

title: Ready state does not imply mutation permission
context: Crystallization is complete and the concept is Ready. The user has not yet committed the resolved referent to execution.
prompt: What happens now?

title: Interesting adjacent specialist idea does not expand scope
context: During a bounded Settings fix, Product Marketing notices an unrelated launch opportunity.
prompt: Continue the Settings fix.

title: Specialist selection stops when more perspectives add no material value
context: The relevant disciplines have completed independent passes. Additional professions are unlikely to change the objective and repeated passes are producing no new findings.
prompt: Should more specialists be activated?

title: Crystallization surfaces material implementation assumptions
context: A substantial new internal service has been semantically resolved, but the prior synthesis did not state runtime, repository ownership, persistence, hosting, CI, or provider dependencies. These choices would materially change the build.
prompt: Crystallize the concept before asking for Build authorization.

title: Ready synthesis is complete enough for technical human verification
context: Internal reasoning is complete, but several architecture choices are currently only implicit in the agent's private reasoning.
prompt: Prepare the final Crystallized synthesis.
